purpose: First conditional isothermal small-strain linear-elastic study only; no strength, thermal-strain or service-life prediction.

young_modulus.basis: Anchored to approximate71GPa related CP1/EOSM290/60um value in Constellium Formnext2021 PDFp9; transfer to exact M291 process/state is unverified.

poisson_ratio.basis: Declared research hypothesis; no matched CP1 measurement found.

uniform_isothermal_temperature.basis: Chosen research case temperature; not the numeric test temperature of the reported elastic data.

elastic_symmetry.basis: Declared model hypothesis; no measured tensor/isotropy qualification for the exact process.

coefficient_temperature_dependence.basis: No E(T),nu(T) or thermoelastic law supplied.

nominal_process_reference.basis: Manufacturer process identity only; neither physical alloy/process selection nor qualified recipe.

provenance.source_limit: Related modulus box does not bind exact M291/argon125C, numeric elastic-test temperature, direction or heat state; nu absent. Publicly reachable deck carries confidentiality footer; no deck copied or redistributed.

requirements_before_use: Accepted mesh for the declared study scope.
Explicit assumed load facets/magnitudes, constraints, contact and reaction path; no invented OEM interfaces.
Balance and convergence checks; record assumptions separately from measured facts.
